about:
RANE is a global risk intelligence company that provides risk and security professionals with critical insights and analysis to more efficiently anticipate, monitor, and respond to emerging threats.

RANE's platform helps organizations identify, manage, and mitigate operational risks, with trusted intelligence that ensures business continuity and resiliency. We provide tools to harness the value of OSINT, analysis to provide context, forecasts to provide direction, and assessments to enable specific action.

about:
ChainSys is an innovator in the data management and business platform implementation (ERP) space. Our success is largely attributed to the fact that we understand the core of how businesses work and the importance of ensuring all business units work smoothly together. Our first product was our own ERP platform, with many companies around the globe currently using it. 

Once we perfected our ERP product, we developed our Smart Data Suite to sit on top of our platform—or work independently and with other platforms—to help companies get their data in order.  

Our platform specializes in migration, integration, consolidation, simplification, master data management, quality, governance and visualization software. 

Without clean, organized, and integrated data, managing a business is a complex and inefficient process. Along the way, we’ve become established partners of Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, etc. gaining a deep understanding of their platforms and how ours can integrate seamlessly to fulfill end to end data needs or fill any data gaps our clients may have.
specialties: data migration for enterprise applications (on-prem and cloud)

about: MarketPro is the leading high-end executive search firm delivering top performing innovative marketers. As a team of former marketing professionals, we are uniquely qualified to separate “A” players from everyone else to find the best marketing talent to impact your business. We regularly place candidates Director through C suite in all facets of marketing including Chief Marketing Officer, Chief Product Officer, Head of Marketing, Head of Digital Marketing, Head of Product Marketing and Head of eCommerce for VC and PE backed companies, as well as global brands.

Pod.ai is a platform for universities, colleges, and companies to not only transform learning, skill development but also to revolutionize campus recruitments. 

We have worked with several companies to transform their end-to-end recruitment processes ensuring that they are able to  find the right talent across all campuses without being limited by their reach or resources, from start to finish—beginning with branding, identifying colleges, conducting assessments and interviews, offer management, engaging and training selected candidates to assisting in joining.

Our mission extends to  working with various colleges and universities spread across the nation to assist them in elevating the quality of education, trainings; and campus placements in colleges, leading to empowering students to achieve their full potential and achieve continuous learning to discover the right career paths. 

In our journey so far to nurture talent and revolutionize campus recruitments, we’ve touched the lives of 2 million+ individuals. We have been able to achieve this in collaboration with various esteemed institutions such as IIT Bombay, IIT Tirupati, SRM University, GGSIPU, LNMIIT, DY Patil, and many more. We have also successfully collaborated with many organizations such as JSW Group, Luminous, Chaayos, CaratLane, HomeFirst, and Bandhan Bank.

Our culture is fueled by continuous learning and a growth mindset, fostering a supportive environment where every stakeholder is empowered to innovate and drive our collective success. Our eyes are now set on creating a deep impact on 100 million+ lives by December 2026.

Our team is always eager to have discussions on elevating recruitments, building strong organizations, developing talent, transforming education. Please feel free to reach out to us. 

Interested in seeing how Pod.ai can benefit you? Request a live demo! Contact us at connect@pod.ai for further assistance and details.
